name: Interactio
description_en:
Interactio provides multilingual meeting and remote-interpretation workflows for online, on-site and hybrid events. Its current official .io URL redirects to interactio.com, whose product includes moderator, interpreter, participant and AV roles.

It is more specialized than an ordinary video-call link: the organizer must coordinate floor audio, interpretation channels, speakers/listeners and technical support. Human interpretation and AI translation are distinct options, not interchangeable quality guarantees.
description_zh:
Interactio 为线上、现场及混合活动提供多语言会议和远程口译流程。当前官方 .io 网址跳至 interactio.com，产品区分主持、口译、参与者及音视频技术角色。

它比普通视频链接更专门，组织者需协调原声、口译频道、发言/收听者和技术支持。人工口译与 AI 翻译是不同选项，不是可互换的质量保证。

core_features.name_zh: 按角色提供口译控制台
core_features.explanation_en: Interpreters manage languages/handovers; moderators control the floor and AV staff monitor channels.
core_features.explanation_zh: 口译员管理语言/交接，主持控制发言，技术员监控频道。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect remote participants, on-site equipment and interpretation channels under an event setup.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在活动配置中连接远程参与者、现场设备及口译频道。

en: An organizer creates the event/languages and invites speakers, interpreters and moderators. The AV manager checks the source feed, interpreters select channels and hand over to a booth partner, and listeners choose their language. A listener cannot necessarily take the floor like a speaker. Rehearse language switching, an interpreter handover and a missing source feed. No event was executed.
zh: 组织者创建活动/语言，邀请发言者、口译员及主持人。技术员检查原声，口译员选频道并与搭档交接，听众选择语言。听众未必像发言者一样可取得发言权。应彩排语言切换、口译交接及原声缺失。本次未执行活动。

sections.en:
An organizer creates the event/languages and invites speakers, interpreters and moderators. The AV manager checks the source feed, interpreters select channels and hand over to a booth partner, and listeners choose their language. A listener cannot necessarily take the floor like a speaker. Rehearse language switching, an interpreter handover and a missing source feed. No event was executed.

A working video stream is not proof that every interpretation channel is intelligible or correctly mapped.
sections.zh:
组织者创建活动/语言，邀请发言者、口译员及主持人。技术员检查原声，口译员选频道并与搭档交接，听众选择语言。听众未必像发言者一样可取得发言权。应彩排语言切换、口译交接及原声缺失。本次未执行活动。

视频直播正常不证明每个口译频道可听清或映射正确。

sections.title_en: An event-specific scope determines the offer
sections.en:
The official quote page asks for the event’s needs and offers a customized proposal. It describes interpreter sourcing, hardware integration and project/technical support, without a public numeric tariff. Leave the amount blank. Supply dates, languages, human/AI choice, audience/speaker numbers, existing conferencing tools, recordings and rehearsal/support needs.

Confirm whether interpreters, equipment, travel, extra hours and recording delivery are included. A demo is not evidence of a free production event or unlimited language capacity under one fee.
sections.zh:
官方询价页要求说明活动需求并提供定制方案，介绍口译人员匹配、硬件集成及项目/技术支持，没有公开数字费率，金额留空。应提供日期、语言、人工/AI 选择、观众/发言人数、已有会议工具、录制及彩排/支持需求。

需确认口译员、设备、差旅、额外小时及录制交付是否包含。演示不代表生产活动免费，或一个费用下语言容量不限。

sections.title_en: Multilingual operations need a technical owner
sections.title_zh: 多语言运营需要技术负责人
sections.en:
Organizations running interpreted conferences or formal multilingual meetings can evaluate this workflow; an occasional same-language call may not need the setup. Assign an AV escalation owner and fallback channel; verify every participant role and language before admitting the audience.

No translation accuracy, latency, support recovery, recording, regulatory suitability, software licence or self-hosting rights were tested. Official sources span .io/.com because of the observed redirect, not fabricated same-domain links.
sections.zh:
举办口译会议或正式多语言讨论的组织可评估该流程，偶尔同语言通话可能无需这套配置。应指定音视频升级负责人及备用频道，观众进入前核对每种角色和语言。

未测试翻译准确性、延迟、支持恢复、录制、监管适用性、软件许可或自托管权。来源跨 .io/.com 是实际跳转，并未伪造同域链接。
